chunks: The obligations of hajj are seven: ihram; the four talbiyah phrases by which one recites privately, and they are: “Labbayka Allahumma labbayka labbayka, la sharika laka labbayka, inna al-hamda wa al-ni'mata laka wa al-mulka la sharika laka”; tawaf of the House; the two rak'ahs at the مقام of Ibrahim عليه السلام; the sa'i between al-Safa and al-Marwah; standing at al-Mash'ar al-Haram; and the hady for the mutamatti'.

key_terms.التَّلْبِيَاتُ: the prescribed formulae of response recited in hajj
key_terms.السَّعْيُ: the ritual traversal between al-Safa and al-Marwah
key_terms.الْإِحْرَامُ: entering the consecrated state for hajj
key_terms.الْحَجِّ: the pilgrimage to the Sacred House
key_terms.الْهَدْيُ: the sacrificial offering due in tamattu' hajj
key_terms.الْوُقُوفُ: the ritual standing at a designated sacred site
key_terms.فَرَائِضُ: obligatory duties that are legally required

ai.seo_question: What are the obligatory acts of hajj according to this narration in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This text lists seven obligatory acts of hajj in a concise legal format. It identifies core rites beginning with ihram and talbiyah, followed by tawaf, prayer at Maqam Ibrahim عليه السلام, sa'i, الوقوف at al-Mash'ar al-Haram, and the sacrificial offering for the mutamatti'.
